entities.name: Chloé Hayden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chloé Sarah Hayden is an Australian actress, author, podcast host, social media personality, and an activist in the disability rights movement. After gaining early attention on social media, she became known for her performance of Quinn "Quinni" Gallagher-Jones in the Netflix comedy drama series Heartbreak High, for which she won an AACTA Award and was nominated for two Logie Awards.
